''With apologies to [https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0449088/ Hans Zimmer] and [https://youtube.com/watch?v=xkzy_420hts Bobby Bass], I present ''Void of Colours'' as written by the servants of the [[Shadow]].''

[[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida]]'s a wreck<br />
Stole the stole from Siuan's neck<br />
Unbound her from her [[Three Oaths|Oaths]]<br />
The [[White Tower|Tower]] is ours<br />
And by [[Dark One|His]] power<br />
The Blue they all will loath

Hear ye, all lands<br />
Raise six colors high<br />
Red, White, Grey, and Yellow<br />
Green and Brown shall vie

Now some have died<br />
And some are alive<br />
And others with [[Logain]] flee<br />
With [[Leane Sharif|Domani]] to sway<br />
And the [[Gareth Bryne|Captain]] to pay<br />
They will [[Salidar]] see.

Hear ye, all lands<br />
The [[Supreme Council|Council]] wields their might<br />
Black souls, thieves, and killers<br />
Never shall they die

Thirteen, all together<br />
[[Lord of Chaos|Raise the chaos high]]<br />
Black souls, thieves, and killers<br />
Never shall they die

Chosen are raised<br />
From their [[Shayol Ghul|ghuley]] grave<br />
Do you hear [[Blood Calls Blood|blood's sepulchral tone]]?<br />
It calls to all<br />
We must [[Lews Therin|Lews]] stall<br />
And turn [[Seanchan|raven]] sails from home

Hear ye, all lands<br />
Let no [[Darkfriend]] be shy<br />
[[Shadowsouled]], [[Darkhound|hounds]], and [[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 29|beggars]]<br />
Never shall we die

Let us. Fight. Each other.<br />
Raise the selfishness high<br />
Burn our souls to cinder<br />
Never shall we die
